items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as food and medicine ('land of milk and honey'; Proverbs 24:13; Quran 16:69 'healing for mankind'), for cough, wounds and digestion
items.caution: Never give to infants under 12 months (botulism). Sugar load for diabetes. Bee allergy.

items.name: Sabbath rest (weekly day of rest)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a commanded weekly rest for body and spirit
items.caution: None.

items.name: Singing, chanting and hymns
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for worship, mood and community
items.caution: None.

items.name: Sleep (rest and regular schedule)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally rest as gift and healer
items.caution: Treat snoring/apnea; avoid sedative herbs + drugs combos.

items.name: Sprouted-grain bread (Ezekiel 4:9 style)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a mixed grain-and-legume bread
items.caution: Contains gluten.

items.name: Wine 'for the stomach's sake' (1 Tim 5:23)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a little wine for digestion and frequent ailments; mixed with oil on wounds
items.caution: ⚠️ Alcohol: cancer, liver, addiction, interactions; none in pregnancy. Tracking only, not a recommendation.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Black seed / Nigella sativa (habbatul barakah)
items.tradition: Middle Eastern; Islamic (Prophetic: 'a cure for every disease except death')
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for virtually every ailment: asthma, allergies, digestion, immunity, blood sugar
items.caution: May lower BP and blood sugar; bleeding risk; rare kidney injury case reports with high doses; avoid large amounts in pregnancy; topical oil can cause contact dermatitis.

items.name: Camel milk
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for diabetes, autism and vitality
items.caution: ⚠️ Raw camel milk carries Brucella and MERS risk; drink pasteurized.

items.name: Costus root (qust al-hindi; Saussurea costus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for throat infections, pleurisy and worms
items.caution: ⚠️ Some imported 'costus' products have been adulterated with or confused with Aristolochia (kidney toxin); buy authenticated only.

items.name: Cumin (kammun)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for digestion, gas and colic
items.caution: Food-safe; may lower blood sugar at extract doses.

items.name: Dates
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to break fasts, as strength food, and in late pregnancy to ease labor (Quran 19:25)
items.caution: High sugar; diabetes portion control.

items.name: Henna (Lawsonia inermis, natural)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to cool the skin, on hair, nails, wounds and ceremonies
items.caution: Avoid 'black henna' (PPD); never on G6PD-deficient infants (hemolysis).

items.name: Hijama (wet cupping)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally done on recommended lunar dates to draw out 'bad blood' and heal
items.caution: ⚠️ Infection, scarring, anemia; requires sterile technique; avoid on anticoagulants.

items.name: Mastic gum (Pistacia lentiscus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for stomach ulcers, digestion and oral health
items.caution: Pistachio/cashew allergy.

items.name: Miswak (Salvadora persica chewing stick)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to clean teeth and freshen breath before prayer
items.caution: Use with fluoride toothpaste for cavity protection; gum injury if aggressive.

items.name: Ramadan / dawn-to-dusk fasting
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a month of spiritual fasting from dawn to sunset
items.caution: Dehydration in heat; diabetes medicine adjustments needed; exempt for illness and pregnancy per tradition.

items.name: Rose water (Rosa damascena)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for calm, skin, eyes and heart
items.caution: Don't use non-sterile rose water in eyes.

items.name: Saffron
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for mood, menstrual pain and vitality
items.caution: High doses (>5 g) toxic; uterine stimulant—avoid in pregnancy; adulterated products.

items.name: Senna (leaf/pod)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a purging laxative and 'cleanse'
items.caution: Short-term use; cramping; low potassium and dependence with chronic use; not with bowel obstruction or in children without a doctor.

items.name: Za'atar (thyme/oregano/sumac/sesame blend)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally eaten for memory and strength (folk: children eat before exams)
items.caution: Food-safe; sesame allergy.

items.name: Zamzam / blessed water and recitation (ruqyah)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for spiritual healing and protection
items.caution: Never a substitute for medical care.

items.name: Abhyanga (warm oil self-massage)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for nervous-system calm, skin and sleep
items.caution: Slippery floors; nut-oil allergy.

items.name: Ajwain (carom seed)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for gas, indigestion, colic and worms
items.caution: Food amounts safe; concentrated oil (thymol) irritant; avoid large amounts in pregnancy.

items.name: Amla / Indian gooseberry (Emblica officinalis)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a rasayana for vitality, hair, digestion and immunity
items.caution: May increase bleeding with anticoagulants; acidic.

items.name: Arjuna (Terminalia arjuna)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a heart tonic
items.caution: ⚠️ May interact with heart and blood pressure drugs; anyone with heart disease must involve cardiologist.

items.name: Asafoetida (hing)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for gas, bloating and colic
items.caution: Do not give to infants (methemoglobinemia reported); may contain wheat flour (gluten).

items.name: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a rasayana (rejuvenator) for stress, sleep, strength and vitality
items.caution: ⚠️ Rare liver injury reports; may affect thyroid hormone levels; avoid in pregnancy; caution with sedatives, thyroid, immunosuppressant and diabetes drugs. Some European countries have restricted it.

items.name: Black pepper / piperine
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to stimulate digestion and carry other herbs
items.caution: Raises levels of some drugs; heartburn.

items.name: Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to enhance memory, learning and calm
items.caution: GI upset, cramps, nausea; may slow heart rate; thyroid and sedative interactions.

items.name: Cardamom
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for digestion, breath and nausea
items.caution: Food-safe; may trigger gallstone colic (folk caution).

items.name: CCF tea (cumin, coriander, fennel)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to aid digestion and gentle detox
items.caution: Food-safe.

items.name: Clove (Syzygium aromaticum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for toothache, digestion and (cleanse protocols) parasite eggs
items.caution: Clove oil swallowed by children can cause liver failure and seizures; can burn gums; bleeding risk.

items.name: Coconut oil
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for skin, hair, cooking and oil pulling
items.caution: Saturated fat/LDL; fine topically.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Fenugreek (methi; Middle Eastern hilba)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for blood sugar, digestion, lactation and strength
items.caution: May lower blood sugar; avoid in pregnancy (uterine contractions); maple-syrup body odor; peanut/chickpea cross-allergy; warfarin.

items.name: Ghee (clarified butter)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a nourishing food and carrier for herbs
items.caution: High saturated fat; LDL caution.

items.name: Giloy / guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for fever, immunity and diabetes
items.caution: ⚠️ Liver injury reports; may unmask autoimmune disease; lowers blood sugar.

items.name: Ginger (Zingiber officinale)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for nausea, digestion, colds, circulation and joint pain
items.caution: High doses may add to blood thinners; heartburn; discuss with doctor in pregnancy beyond food amounts.

items.name: Golden milk (turmeric + pepper + milk)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally an evening drink for sleep, colds and joints
items.caution: See turmeric; dairy intolerance.

items.name: Gotu kola (Centella asiatica)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for wound healing, memory and longevity
items.caution: ⚠️ Rare liver injury case reports; sedative effect; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Guggul (Commiphora wightii)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cholesterol, joints and weight
items.caution: ⚠️ Rash, GI upset; may interact with thyroid drugs, propranolol, diltiazem, anticoagulants, estrogen-sensitive conditions.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Gymnema (gurmar, 'sugar destroyer')
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to curb sugar cravings and for diabetes
items.caution: Hypoglycemia with diabetes drugs; rare liver injury reports.

items.name: Haritaki (Terminalia chebula)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally the 'king of medicines' for digestion and longevity
items.caution: Laxative; avoid in pregnancy and dehydration.

items.name: Holy basil + ginger + honey kadha (Ayurvedic decoction)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a home immune drink for colds
items.caution: Honey not for infants; excess consumption caused acidity reports.

items.name: Hydration and water drinking (morning warm water)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally warm water at waking to cleanse
items.caution: Overhydration (hyponatremia) with extreme intake.

items.name: Jamun seed (Syzygium cumini)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for diabetes
items.caution: Hypoglycemia with diabetes drugs.

items.name: Kitchari cleanse (rice + mung bean mono-diet)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a gentle 3-7 day digestive reset
items.caution: Generally safe; low in some nutrients if prolonged.

items.name: Kutki (Picrorhiza kurroa)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a bitter liver herb
items.caution: Strong laxative; autoimmune stimulation theory; caution with immunosuppressants.

items.name: Licorice root (yashtimadhu; gan cao)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sore throat, stomach ulcers, cough and to harmonize formulas
items.caution: ⚠️ Glycyrrhizin causes high blood pressure, low potassium, fluid retention and arrhythmia with regular use; avoid in hypertension, heart/kidney disease, pregnancy, and with diuretics/digoxin.

items.name: Meditation
items.traditional_use: Traditionally for spiritual insight and peace
items.caution: Rarely worsens trauma symptoms; seek guidance if distressing.

items.name: Moringa (drumstick tree)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a nutrition and lactation food, for blood sugar and inflammation
items.caution: Root and bark can be toxic and abortifacient; may lower blood sugar and blood pressure; possible interaction with levothyroxine.

items.name: Nasal saline rinse / neti pot (jala neti)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to cleanse sinuses and support breathing
items.caution: Use only distilled, sterile or boiled-then-cooled water (fatal Naegleria amoeba infections from tap water).

items.name: Neem (Azadirachta indica)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for skin conditions, lice, gum health, fever and parasites
items.caution: ⚠️ Neem oil taken by mouth has caused severe poisoning (encephalopathy, Reye-like) in young children; avoid internally, in pregnancy and when trying to conceive.

items.name: Oil pulling (kavala/gandusha)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally swished 5-20 min for oral health, detox and whole-body claims
items.caution: Do not swallow; spit in trash (clogs drains); rare lipoid pneumonia from aspiration.

items.name: Panchakarma (purgation, emesis, enema)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a seasonal deep detox program
items.caution: ⚠️ Induced vomiting/purgation risks dehydration, electrolyte imbalance; only under qualified supervision.

items.name: Pranayama (yogic breathing)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to control prana (life force), calm mind
items.caution: Avoid forceful breath retention with heart disease, pregnancy, epilepsy; never in water or while driving.

items.name: Psyllium (ispaghula)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for constipation, diarrhea and piles
items.caution: Must take with plenty of water (choking/blockage); separate from medicines by 2 hours; allergy (inhaled powder).

items.name: Sesame oil
items.traditional_use: Traditionally the main massage and pulling oil; warming food
items.caution: Sesame allergy (major allergen).

items.name: Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a female reproductive tonic and to support breastfeeding
items.caution: Asparagus allergy; may affect blood sugar; limited safety data in pregnancy.

items.name: Shilajit (mineral pitch)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a rasayana for energy, vitality and male health
items.caution: ⚠️ Raw/unpurified shilajit can contain lead, arsenic, mercury; buy only third-party tested; limited safety data.

items.name: Tongue scraping (jihwa prakshalana)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally done each morning to remove ama (toxins) and freshen breath
items.caution: Do gently; avoid injury.

items.name: Trikatu (ginger + black pepper + long pepper)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to kindle digestive fire (agni) and boost absorption
items.caution: Piperine can raise blood levels of drugs (e.g., phenytoin, propranolol); heartburn.

items.name: Triphala (amla + haritaki + bibhitaki)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a gentle bowel tonic, detox and eye/oral health formula
items.caution: Laxative effect, cramps, diarrhea; possible interactions; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Tulsi / holy basil (Ocimum tenuiflorum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as an adaptogen for stress, colds, cough and blood sugar
items.caution: May lower blood sugar; possible anti-fertility effects in animals (avoid if trying to conceive/pregnant); may slow clotting.

items.name: Turmeric / curcumin
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for inflammation, joints, skin, wounds and digestion
items.caution: Liver injury reported with concentrated supplements (especially with piperine); gallstones; may add to blood thinners and diabetes drugs. Food amounts are safe.

items.name: Yoga (asana)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a path of union of body, breath and mind
items.caution: Avoid extreme poses with glaucoma, osteoporosis, pregnancy; start with qualified teacher.

items.name: Acupuncture
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to balance qi in meridians for pain and many conditions
items.caution: Use licensed practitioner with sterile single-use needles; rare pneumothorax, infection.

items.name: Artemisia annua (sweet wormwood; qinghao)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for fevers (TCM since 4th c.; source of artemisinin)
items.caution: ⚠️ Inadequate malaria treatment can be fatal; GI upset; avoid in pregnancy (first trimester). For malaria use only real medicines.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Asian ginseng (Panax ginseng; ren shen)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a qi tonic for energy, stamina, longevity and male vitality
items.caution: Insomnia, headache, BP changes; may lower blood sugar; interacts with warfarin, MAOIs, diabetes drugs; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Astragalus (huang qi)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a qi and wei-qi (defensive energy) tonic for immunity and fatigue
items.caution: May interact with immunosuppressants; some Astragalus species (not membranaceus) are toxic livestock 'locoweeds'.

items.name: Chrysanthemum tea (ju hua)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to clear heat, soothe eyes and headaches
items.caution: Ragweed/Asteraceae allergy.

items.name: Congee (rice porridge with herbs)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a healing food for weak digestion and convalescence
items.caution: Food-safe.

items.name: Coptis / berberine (huang lian)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for diarrhea, infection and 'damp heat'
items.caution: ⚠️ Many drug interactions (CYP3A4, cyclosporine, metformin additive); GI upset; never for newborns (kernicterus) or pregnancy.

items.name: Cordyceps
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for stamina, lungs, kidneys and libido
items.caution: May lower blood sugar; bleeding risk; immunosuppressant interaction; lead contamination reported in some wild products.

items.name: Cupping (ba guan; hijama in Islamic tradition)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to move blood/qi and draw out toxins, for pain
items.caution: Bruising, burns (fire cupping), infection with wet cupping; avoid on anticoagulants or bleeding disorders.

items.name: Dan shen (Salvia miltiorrhiza)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to move blood, for heart and circulation
items.caution: ⚠️ Raises warfarin effect (bleeding); antiplatelet effects.

items.name: Dong quai (Angelica sinensis)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally the 'female ginseng' for menstrual and menopausal complaints
items.caution: ⚠️ Bleeding with warfarin; photosensitivity; avoid in pregnancy and hormone-sensitive cancers.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Eucommia bark (du zhong)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to strengthen bones, back and kidneys
items.caution: May lower blood pressure.

items.name: Goji berry (Lycium barbarum; gou qi zi)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to nourish liver, kidneys and eyes, and for longevity
items.caution: Warfarin interaction (bleeding); may lower blood sugar/BP; nightshade-family allergy.

items.name: Green tea
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for alertness, digestion and longevity
items.caution: Concentrated green tea extract pills can cause liver injury; caffeine; reduces nadolol absorption; iron absorption.

items.name: Gua sha (skin scraping)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to release heat and stagnation, for pain
items.caution: Bruising/petechiae; avoid with bleeding disorders, anticoagulants, broken skin.

items.name: Gynostemma (jiaogulan)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally an 'immortality herb' tonic
items.caution: Hypoglycemia; bleeding theory; avoid with immunosuppressants.

items.name: Honeysuckle flower (jin yin hua)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to clear heat and toxins for colds and sore throat
items.caution: Generally safe as tea; bleeding theory.

items.name: Isatis root (ban lan gen)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for flu and sore throat
items.caution: GI upset; allergic reactions reported.

items.name: Jujube (Ziziphus jujuba; da zao)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to calm the spirit, aid sleep and harmonize formulas
items.caution: Food-safe; sugar in dried form.

items.name: Moxibustion
items.traditional_use: Traditionally burning mugwort near acupoints to warm meridians
items.caution: ⚠️ Burns; smoke; in pregnancy only with clinician.

items.name: Poria (fu ling)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to drain dampness and calm the spirit
items.caution: Generally safe.

items.name: Pu-erh (fermented dark tea)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for digestion and to cut grease after meals
items.caution: Caffeine; contamination (molds) possible.

items.name: Qigong
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to cultivate qi with breath and movement
items.caution: Low risk.

items.name: Red yeast rice (hong qu)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to aid digestion and blood circulation
items.caution: ⚠️ Same risks as statins (muscle, liver); citrinin kidney toxin contamination; do not combine with statins; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Rehmannia (shu di huang)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to nourish yin and blood
items.caution: Loose stools; may lower blood sugar.

items.name: Reishi mushroom (Ganoderma lucidum; ling zhi)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally the 'mushroom of immortality' for calm, longevity and immunity
items.caution: Liver toxicity case reports with powdered extracts; may increase bleeding and lower BP; immunosuppressant interaction.

items.name: Royal jelly
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for vitality, fertility and longevity
items.caution: ⚠️ Severe asthma/anaphylaxis reported; warfarin interaction.

items.name: San qi / tian qi (Panax notoginseng)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to stop bleeding and move blood after injury
items.caution: ⚠️ Bleeding interactions; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Schisandra (wu wei zi)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as an adaptogen for stamina, liver and cough
items.caution: Can change levels of many drugs (CYP3A4, e.g., tacrolimus); avoid in pregnancy; heartburn.

items.name: Scutellaria baicalensis (huang qin)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to clear heat, for fever and inflammation
items.caution: ⚠️ Liver injury reports; may affect blood sugar; sedation.

items.name: Shiitake (Lentinula edodes)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for vitality and longevity
items.caution: Raw/undercooked shiitake can cause flagellate 'shiitake dermatitis'.

items.name: Tai chi
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a moving meditation for qi, balance and longevity
items.caution: Low risk; modify for joint problems.

items.name: Thunder god vine (Tripterygium wilfordii)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for joint pain and autoimmune conditions
items.caution: ⚠️ Severe side effects: bone loss, infertility, GI, kidney; poisonous if improperly extracted. Only under specialist care.

items.name: Turkey tail (Coriolus/Trametes versicolor; PSK)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to strengthen immunity and spleen
items.caution: Generally well tolerated; dark stools; may interact with chemo; never replace cancer treatment.

items.name: White mulberry leaf (sang ye)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cough, fever and 'wasting thirst' (diabetes-like)
items.caution: Hypoglycemia with diabetes drugs; GI upset.

items.name: Wood ear / black fungus (Auricularia)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to nourish blood and for circulation
items.caution: Antiplatelet theory; cook well.

items.name: Amazake / koji (fermented rice drink)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a summer energy 'drinkable IV'
items.caution: Sugar content.

items.name: Ginger compress / hot water bottle
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used on abdomen/kidneys for pain and 'toxin release'
items.caution: Burns.

items.name: Hara hachi bu (eat until 80% full)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a Confucian-inspired habit of stopping before full
items.caution: Not for underweight or eating disorders.

items.name: Kampo formulas (e.g., daikenchuto)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally prescribed formulas for digestion, colds and more
items.caution: Prescription formulas; some contain licorice (BP, potassium).

items.name: Kimchi
items.traditional_use: Traditionally eaten at every meal for digestion and health
items.caution: High sodium; high intake of salted/pickled vegetables is associated with stomach cancer in East Asian studies.

items.name: Kombu, wakame, nori (edible seaweeds)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally eaten daily; postpartum seaweed soup in Korea
items.caution: ⚠️ Kombu/kelp iodine excess (thyroid); hijiki is high in inorganic arsenic (avoid).

items.name: Korean red ginseng
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for vitality and immunity
items.caution: See Asian ginseng.

items.name: Kudzu root (kakkonto)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds, neck stiffness and hangovers
items.caution: Estrogenic; may interact with diabetes drugs and methotrexate; liver concerns.

items.name: Maitake (Grifola frondosa)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a vitality/immune mushroom
items.caution: May lower blood sugar and BP; warfarin interaction.

items.name: Miso and miso soup
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a daily soup for digestion and health
items.caution: High sodium; soy allergy.

items.name: Natto (fermented soybeans)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally eaten at breakfast for stamina and longevity
items.caution: Very high vitamin K: interferes with warfarin; soy allergy; nattokinase supplements may add to bleeding risk.

items.name: Onsen / hot-spring and hot-bath bathing
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for pain, skin, relaxation and healing
items.caution: Bath-related drowning/fainting in elderly; alcohol; heart disease caution.

items.name: Shinrin-yoku (forest bathing)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally (modern Japanese practice, rooted in Shinto nature reverence) slow walks in forests for restoration
items.caution: Ticks, allergies.

items.name: Shiso (Perilla)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for food poisoning, colds and allergies
items.caution: Food-safe.

items.name: Umeboshi (pickled ume plum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for fatigue, hangover, nausea and food poisoning
items.caution: Very high sodium.

items.name: American ginseng (Panax quinquefolius)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used by Native nations and in TCM as a cooling tonic for fatigue and colds
items.caution: Hypoglycemia with diabetes drugs; warfarin interaction; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Black cohosh (Actaea racemosa)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for menstrual and labor pain, rheumatism and women's health
items.caution: ⚠️ Liver injury case reports; avoid in pregnancy and liver disease.

items.name: Cranberry
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as food and for urinary and wound problems
items.caution: Juice sugar; possible warfarin interaction at high doses; kidney stone history (oxalate). Not a treatment for active UTI.

items.name: Echinacea (purple coneflower)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used by Plains nations for wounds, snakebite, toothache and infections; now for colds
items.caution: Allergy (Asteraceae/ragweed); not advised in autoimmune disease or with immunosuppressants by some sources.

items.name: Elderberry (Sambucus nigra / canadensis)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds, flu, fevers and as a wild food
items.caution: Raw/unripe berries, leaves, stems and bark contain cyanide-forming compounds (nausea, vomiting); cook berries.

items.name: Eucalyptus leaf / oil (steam)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds, fever, congestion and wounds
items.caution: Swallowing eucalyptus oil is a well-known child poisoning (seizures, coma); do not apply near infant faces.

items.name: Evening primrose oil
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for skin, bruises, and women's hormonal complaints
items.caution: May increase bleeding; seizure-threshold theory with some drugs.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Goldenseal (Hydrastis canadensis)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for skin and eye washes, digestion and infections
items.caution: ⚠️ Inhibits CYP2D6/3A4 (many drug interactions incl. metformin); avoid in pregnancy, breastfeeding, newborns; endangered wild plant.

items.name: Juniper berry
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for urinary health, digestion and purification smoke
items.caution: ⚠️ Kidney irritation with long use; avoid in pregnancy and kidney disease.

items.name: Kakadu plum (Terminalia ferdinandiana)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a bush food and medicine
items.caution: Food-safe; oxalates.

items.name: Kava (Piper methysticum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a ceremonial and social drink for calm and sleep
items.caution: ⚠️ Serious liver injury reports (FDA advisory); do not combine with alcohol or sedatives; avoid with liver disease, driving.

items.name: Manuka / medical-grade honey (topical)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally applied to wounds and burns
items.caution: Use sterilized medical-grade honey on wounds, not kitchen honey. Bee allergy.

items.name: Mullein (Verbascum thapsus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cough, lungs and earache
items.caution: Strain tea well (leaf hairs irritate throat); never put oil in an ear with a ruptured eardrum.

items.name: Noni (Morinda citrifolia)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for many ailments, wounds and tonics
items.caution: ⚠️ High potassium (danger in kidney disease, with ACE inhibitors/potassium drugs); possible liver injury.

items.name: Osha root (Ligusticum porteri)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for respiratory infections and sore throat
items.caution: ⚠️ Easily confused with deadly poison hemlock/water hemlock when wild-harvested; avoid in pregnancy; at-risk plant.

items.name: Pine needle tea (white pine)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for vitamin C, colds and scurvy
items.caution: ⚠️ Some pines (ponderosa, Norfolk Island 'pine', yew which is not a pine) are toxic/abortifacient; avoid in pregnancy; identify species carefully.

items.name: Plantain leaf (Plantago major/lanceolata)
items.tradition: Native American ('white man's footprint'); European folk
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used on stings, bites, wounds and for cough
items.caution: Generally safe; allergy rare.

items.name: Slippery elm (Ulmus rubra)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sore throat, cough, wounds and digestive soothing
items.caution: May slow absorption of other drugs (take apart); traditionally avoided in pregnancy (bark abortifacient lore).

items.name: Sumac (staghorn/smooth sumac berry drink)
items.tradition: Native American; Middle Eastern (Rhus coriaria spice)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a sour vitamin drink and for sore throat; spice in Middle East
items.caution: Do not confuse with poison sumac (white berries); cashew/mango allergy.

items.name: Sweat lodge (inipi)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a purification ceremony for body and spirit
items.caution: ⚠️ Heat stroke, dehydration, deaths; avoid with heart disease, pregnancy, alcohol; only with experienced traditional leaders.

items.name: Sweetgrass, cedar and tobacco (ceremonial)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally sacred medicines for prayer, purification and protection
items.caution: Smoke exposure; ceremonial tobacco is offered, not inhaled recreationally.

items.name: Tea tree oil (topical)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally crushed leaves were used on wounds, skin infections and colds
items.caution: Toxic if swallowed (confusion, coma); skin irritation/allergy; possible hormonal effects in boys (case reports).

items.name: White sage smudging (Salvia apiana)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally burned in ceremony to purify spaces and people; sacred to many nations
items.caution: Indoor smoke irritates lungs/asthma; fire safety. Respect: sacred practice of specific nations; buy ethically sourced or grow.

items.name: Willow bark (Salix)
items.tradition: Native American; European folk; ancient Egyptian/Greek
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for pain, fever and inflammation (source of salicin, the aspirin precursor)
items.caution: ⚠️ Salicylate: avoid with aspirin allergy, children/teens (Reye's syndrome), bleeding disorders, anticoagulants, kidney disease, pregnancy.

items.name: Witch hazel (topical)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used on bruises, insect bites and hemorrhoids
items.caution: Topical only; skin irritation.

items.name: Yarrow (Achillea millefolium)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to stop bleeding, for fever (sweating), digestion and menstrual cramps
items.caution: Asteraceae allergy; avoid in pregnancy (thujone traces); photosensitivity.

items.name: Boldo (Peumus boldus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for liver, gallbladder and digestion
items.caution: ⚠️ Liver toxicity (ascaridole in oil); avoid in pregnancy, gallstones, with warfarin.

items.name: Cacao / dark chocolate
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a sacred drink for vitality, mood and heart
items.caution: Calories/sugar; caffeine/theobromine; heavy metals (lead/cadmium) found in some dark chocolates.

items.name: Cat's claw (Uncaria tomentosa; una de gato)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for inflammation, arthritis, wounds and immunity
items.caution: May interact with anticoagulants, immunosuppressants and BP drugs; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Chanca piedra (Phyllanthus niruri, 'stone breaker')
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to break kidney and gallstones and for liver
items.caution: May lower blood sugar and BP; lithium interaction (diuretic theory).

items.name: Chia seed
items.traditional_use: Traditionally an endurance food for runners and warriors
items.caution: Dry seeds swallowed then water can cause esophageal blockage; soak first.

items.name: Copaiba oil
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for wounds, inflammation and sore throat
items.caution: Internal use: GI upset; rash; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Damiana (Turnera diffusa)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as an aphrodisiac and mood tonic
items.caution: May lower blood sugar; high doses reported convulsions (historic).

items.name: Dragon's blood (sangre de grado, Croton lechleri)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for wounds and diarrhea
items.caution: Raw sap: limited safety data; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Epazote (Dysphania ambrosioides; wormseed)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to expel worms and reduce bean gas
items.caution: ⚠️ Epazote oil is toxic (seizures, liver/kidney damage, deaths); keep to culinary amounts; avoid in pregnancy and children.

items.name: Guava leaf tea
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for diarrhea and blood sugar
items.caution: Hypoglycemia with diabetes drugs.

items.name: Guayusa (Ilex guayusa)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally drunk before dawn for alertness and dream-sharing
items.caution: Caffeine.

items.name: Maca (Lepidium meyenii)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for stamina, fertility and libido at altitude
items.caution: Generally food-safe; goitrogen theory (thyroid).

items.name: Nopal / prickly pear cactus
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for diabetes, hangovers and wounds
items.caution: Hypoglycemia with diabetes drugs; GI upset.

items.name: Pau d'arco (Tabebuia / Handroanthus bark)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for infections, candida and cancer
items.caution: ⚠️ Bleeding (anticoagulant effect), nausea at high doses; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Spirulina / chlorella
items.traditional_use: Traditionally (Aztec) a lake algae food; modern 'superfood' and detox
items.caution: Contamination with liver-toxic microcystins; avoid with autoimmune disease, PKU (spirulina); warfarin (chlorella vitamin K).

items.name: Yerba mate
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a social energizing drink and appetite suppressant
items.caution: Caffeine; drink warm not scalding (hot beverages >65°C probable carcinogen); PAH content in smoked leaves.

items.name: Apple cider vinegar
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for digestion, weight, blood sugar and as a wash
items.caution: Always dilute; erodes tooth enamel, can burn esophagus; low potassium with high intake; delays stomach emptying (gastroparesis).

items.name: Arnica (topical)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used on bruises, sprains and sore muscles
items.caution: Never take undiluted arnica by mouth (toxic); avoid on broken skin; Asteraceae allergy. Homeopathic dilutions contain essentially no arnica.

items.name: Artichoke leaf
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for digestion, liver and gallbladder
items.caution: Asteraceae allergy; gallstone/bile duct obstruction.

items.name: Bilberry
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for night vision, diarrhea and circulation
items.caution: Food-safe; extract may add to blood thinners.

items.name: Birch leaf
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for urinary flushing and spring cleanse
items.caution: Avoid with heart/kidney edema; birch pollen allergy.

items.name: Black currant leaf
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for joint pain and as a diuretic
items.caution: Diuretic; avoid with heart or kidney edema.

items.name: Butterbur (Petasites)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for migraine, cough and allergies
items.caution: ⚠️ Raw plant contains liver-toxic pyrrolizidine alkaloids; use only certified PA-free extracts; liver injury reports even so.

items.name: Calendula (marigold, topical)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for wounds, rashes and skin inflammation
items.caution: Asteraceae allergy.

items.name: Castor oil (packs; oral)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for constipation, liver 'detox' packs, labor induction and skin
items.caution: ⚠️ Oral: severe cramps, diarrhea; do not self-induce labor; seeds (ricin) are deadly—oil only.

items.name: Chamomile (German, Matricaria)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sleep, calm, colic, upset stomach and skin
items.caution: Ragweed/Asteraceae allergy (rare anaphylaxis); possible warfarin and cyclosporine interactions.

items.name: Chasteberry (Vitex)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for menstrual and hormonal complaints
items.caution: Interferes with hormones, birth control, dopamine drugs; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Chicken soup
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds and recovery
items.caution: Sodium.

items.name: Comfrey (Symphytum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used on sprains, bruises and broken bones; formerly taken as tea
items.caution: ⚠️ Oral comfrey: pyrrolizidine alkaloids cause liver veno-occlusive disease (FDA advised removal of oral products). Topical only, short term, intact skin, not in pregnancy.

items.name: Dandelion (Taraxacum)
items.tradition: European folk; TCM (pu gong ying); Native American
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a liver/digestive bitter, diuretic and spring tonic
items.caution: Asteraceae allergy; diuretic (lithium, potassium); gallbladder disease.

items.name: Elderflower (Sambucus flowers)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to induce sweating in feverish colds
items.caution: Use flowers only; other plant parts toxic raw.

items.name: Fennel seed
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for gas, colic, breastfeeding and digestion
items.caution: Celery/carrot allergy; estragole concerns: avoid long-term medicinal use in infants/pregnancy.

items.name: Feverfew
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for fever, headaches and migraine
items.caution: Mouth sores from fresh leaves; post-feverfew syndrome on stopping; bleeding; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Fire cider (vinegar herbal tonic)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a winter immune and warming tonic (vinegar steeped with horseradish, garlic, onion, ginger, hot pepper, honey)
items.caution: Acidic (dilute; enamel); reflux; honey not for infants.

items.name: Flaxseed / linseed
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for constipation, cough and poultices
items.caution: Take with plenty of water; may slow drug absorption; bowel obstruction risk with strictures.

items.name: Garden sage (Salvia officinalis)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sore throat, sweating, memory and digestion
items.caution: Sage oil/large doses contain thujone (seizures); avoid concentrated amounts in pregnancy and epilepsy.

items.name: Gentian and digestive bitters
items.traditional_use: Traditionally taken before meals to stimulate appetite and digestion
items.caution: Avoid with ulcers/gastritis; alcohol in tinctures.

items.name: Goldenrod (Solidago)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for urinary and kidney complaints
items.caution: Asteraceae allergy; avoid with heart/kidney edema.

items.name: Hawthorn (Crataegus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a heart and circulation tonic
items.caution: ⚠️ Interacts with heart drugs (digoxin, beta-blockers, nitrates); never self-treat heart failure.

items.name: Hops (Humulus lupulus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sleep and restlessness
items.caution: Sedation; estrogenic activity (caution with hormone-sensitive conditions).

items.name: Horehound (Marrubium)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cough and digestion
items.caution: May lower blood sugar; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Horse chestnut seed extract
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for varicose veins, swollen legs and hemorrhoids
items.caution: ⚠️ Raw seeds/bark/leaves are poisonous (esculin); use only standardized escin extract; bleeding and blood-sugar interactions.

items.name: Horsetail (Equisetum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for urinary flushing, hair, nails and bones
items.caution: ⚠️ Contains thiaminase (B1 depletion with long use); nicotine traces; lithium/diuretic interactions.

items.name: Hot toddy (honey, lemon, whiskey)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds and sleep
items.caution: ⚠️ Alcohol: no for children, pregnancy, meds, liver disease.

items.name: Ivy leaf (Hedera helix)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for productive cough and bronchitis
items.caution: Nausea; not for children under 2.

items.name: Kefir and yogurt (cultured milk)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for longevity and digestion
items.caution: Lactose; immunocompromised people should ask about live cultures.

items.name: Kneipp hydrotherapy (alternating water)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to strengthen immunity and circulation
items.caution: Cold exposure risks in heart disease.

items.name: Lemon balm (Melissa officinalis)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for calm, sleep, nervous stomach and cold sores
items.caution: Sedative additive effect; may affect thyroid hormone (theory).

items.name: Linden flower (Tilia)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds, fevers and nervous tension
items.caution: Generally safe; rare allergy.

items.name: Marshmallow root (Althaea)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to soothe dry cough, sore throat and stomach
items.caution: May slow absorption of other drugs (take apart); may lower blood sugar.

items.name: Milk thistle (silymarin)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for liver and gallbladder protection, mushroom poisoning
items.caution: Asteraceae allergy; GI upset; may lower blood sugar.

items.name: Mugwort (Artemisia vulgaris)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for dreams, menstruation, digestion and protection
items.caution: ⚠️ Avoid in pregnancy (uterine stimulant); Asteraceae and celery-mugwort-spice allergy; thujone.

items.name: Onion poultice / onion syrup
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for earaches, chest congestion and cough
items.caution: ⚠️ Skin irritation; never insert onion into ear canal.

items.name: Oregano oil (Origanum vulgare)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for infections, colds and parasites
items.caution: ⚠️ Oil is caustic undiluted; GI upset; Lamiaceae allergy; may interfere with iron absorption; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Peppermint (and peppermint oil)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for indigestion, gas, nausea and headaches
items.caution: Heartburn/GERD can worsen; never put menthol oil near infants' faces; enteric capsules shouldn't be taken with antacids.

items.name: Propolis (bee glue)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for wounds, mouth sores and sore throats
items.caution: Bee/poplar allergy and contact dermatitis; asthma.

items.name: Quercetin-rich foods (onions, apples, capers)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally (folk) used for allergies and heart
items.caution: Food-safe; supplement drug interactions.

items.name: Red clover
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a blood-cleansing tonic, for skin and cough
items.caution: Estrogen-like; caution with hormone-sensitive cancers, anticoagulants.

items.name: Rose hips
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for vitamin C, colds and joint pain
items.caution: Food-safe; strain irritating hairs.

items.name: Rosemary
items.traditional_use: Traditionally 'for remembrance', circulation and digestion
items.caution: Food-safe; large amounts/oil may trigger seizures; avoid medicinal doses in pregnancy.

items.name: Salt-water gargle
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sore throat and to prevent colds
items.caution: Don't swallow large amounts (sodium).

items.name: Sauerkraut (raw, lacto-fermented)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for digestion, scurvy prevention and winter health
items.caution: High sodium; histamine intolerance; gas.

items.name: Sea buckthorn
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for skin, mucous membranes and vitality
items.caution: May add to blood thinners.

items.name: St John's wort (Hypericum perforatum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for melancholy, wounds and nerve pain
items.caution: ⚠️ Dangerous interactions: lowers birth control, HIV drugs, transplant drugs, warfarin, digoxin; serotonin syndrome with SSRIs; photosensitivity. Depression needs professional care.

items.name: Stinging nettle (Urtica dioica)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used as a spring tonic, for allergies, arthritis, urinary flow and anemia
items.caution: Diuretic; may affect BP, blood sugar, lithium, warfarin (vitamin K); cook or dry leaves before eating.

items.name: Thyme (Thymus vulgaris)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cough, bronchitis and digestion
items.caution: Food-safe; thyme oil is irritant internally; Lamiaceae allergy.

items.name: Uva ursi (bearberry)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for bladder infections
items.caution: ⚠️ Hydroquinone toxicity: max ~1 week, few times a year; not in pregnancy, children or kidney disease.

items.name: Valerian root
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sleep and nervousness
items.caution: Sedation (no driving), additive with alcohol/sedatives; rare liver injury reports.

items.name: African potato (Hypoxis hemerocallidea)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for immunity, prostate and wasting
items.caution: ⚠️ Do not combine with HIV drugs; toxicity.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Artemisia afra (African wormwood)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cough, colds, fever and worms
items.caution: ⚠️ Thujone; same cautions as wormwood.

items.name: Baobab fruit powder
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for diarrhea, fever and vitality
items.caution: Food-safe.

items.name: Bitter leaf (Vernonia amygdalina)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for malaria, diabetes, worms and digestion
items.caution: May lower blood sugar; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Bitter melon / cerasee (Momordica charantia)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for diabetes, 'cleansing the blood', worms and fevers
items.caution: ⚠️ Hypoglycemia with diabetes drugs; seeds/red arils toxic to children (favism-like hemolysis in G6PD deficiency); abortifacient—avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Buchu (Agathosma)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for urinary infections and as a diuretic
items.caution: ⚠️ Pulegone in oil (liver toxicity); avoid in pregnancy, kidney disease.

items.name: Devil's claw (Harpagophytum procumbens)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for pain, fever and digestion
items.caution: GI upset; avoid with ulcers, gallstones; may interact with warfarin, diabetes and stomach-acid drugs.

items.name: Fever grass / lemongrass (Cymbopogon citratus)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for fever, colds, anxiety and digestion
items.caution: Food-safe as tea; oil irritant.

items.name: Guinea hen weed (Petiveria alliacea; anamu)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds, pain, immunity and (claims) cancer
items.caution: ⚠️ May lower blood sugar; anticoagulant theory; abortifacient folk use—avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Honeybush (Cyclopia)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cough and as a tonic
items.caution: Generally safe.

items.name: Kinkeliba (Combretum micranthum)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally a 'long life' tea for liver, fever and digestion
items.caution: Generally safe as tea.

items.name: Pygeum (Prunus africana)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for urinary and prostate problems
items.caution: GI upset; overharvesting threatens species.

items.name: Rooibos (red bush)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colic, allergies, skin and calm
items.caution: Caffeine-free; rare liver injury case reports.

items.name: Scotch bonnet / hot pepper
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for colds, circulation and pain
items.caution: Burns skin/eyes; reflux; hemorrhoid flare.

items.name: Shea butter (topical)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for skin, wounds, baby care and joints
items.caution: Rare tree-nut-like allergy concern (low).

items.name: Sorrel / bissap (Hibiscus sabdariffa)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to cool the body, for blood pressure and as a festive drink
items.caution: Additive with BP drugs; may affect acetaminophen and chloroquine levels; avoid medicinal amounts in pregnancy.

items.name: Soursop / graviola leaf (Annona muricata)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sleep, nerves, fever and (modern claim) cancer
items.caution: ⚠️ Neurotoxic (annonacin) with regular leaf/fruit use; may lower BP/blood sugar. Never replace cancer care.

items.name: Sutherlandia (cancer bush)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for fevers, wasting and cancers
items.caution: ⚠️ May interact with antiretrovirals; never replace care.
items.evidence: Studies mostly do not support this

items.name: Black walnut hull (Juglans nigra)
items.tradition: Parasite cleanse; Native American; American folk
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used against intestinal worms, fungal skin infections and as a dye
items.caution: ⚠️ Juglone; GI upset; tree-nut allergy; possible liver/kidney concerns at high dose; avoid in pregnancy.

items.name: Diatomaceous earth (food grade)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally (modern folk) used to 'scrape out' parasites and detox
items.caution: ⚠️ Inhaling dust damages lungs (crystalline silica in non-food grades); constipation.

items.name: Garlic for parasites
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used against worms and Giardia
items.caution: See garlic row (bleeding).

items.name: Mimosa pudica seed
items.traditional_use: Promoted (modern) to bind and expel parasites and 'rope worms'
items.caution: ⚠️ Unknown safety.

items.name: Papaya seeds
items.tradition: Parasite cleanse; African; Caribbean; Latin American
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to expel intestinal worms
items.caution: Possible anti-fertility effects (animal studies); avoid in pregnancy; latex-papain allergy.

items.name: Parasite cleanse protocols (multi-herb kits)
items.traditional_use: Promoted for fatigue, bloating, skin issues as 'everyone has parasites'
items.caution: ⚠️ Laxative and herb toxicities; delays diagnosis. If worried, ask a doctor for a stool ova & parasite test.

items.name: Pumpkin seeds (Cucurbita)
items.tradition: Parasite cleanse; Native American; European; TCM
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used to expel tapeworms; also for prostate
items.caution: Food-safe; calories.

items.name: Breathwork (slow breathing, box breathing)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for calm and focus
items.caution: Hyperventilation dizziness; never in water.

items.name: Cold plunge / cold-water immersion
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for vigor, resilience and immunity
items.caution: Cold shock can cause arrhythmia, drowning; avoid with heart disease, uncontrolled BP, Raynaud's, pregnancy; never alone in open water; start short.

items.name: Dry brushing
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for lymph 'detox', circulation and skin
items.caution: Skin irritation; avoid on eczema/broken skin.

items.name: Epsom salt bath (magnesium sulfate)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for sore muscles, relaxation and 'drawing out toxins'
items.caution: Do not drink Epsom salt (laxative overdose, magnesium toxicity with kidney disease).

items.name: Extended water fasting (3+ days)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for spiritual breakthroughs and 'deep detox'
items.caution: ⚠️ Electrolyte disturbance, refeeding syndrome, gout attack, low BP, medicine dangers; requires medical supervision.

items.name: Forest/green-space walking (non-Japanese)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally time in creation/nature for renewal
items.caution: Ticks.

items.name: Grounding / earthing (barefoot on earth)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally connecting with the earth for calm and sleep
items.caution: Foot injuries, ticks; never use 'grounding' to mains wiring (electrical risk).

items.name: Intermittent fasting (16:8, 5:2)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally fasting for spiritual and bodily cleansing
items.caution: Not for pregnancy, eating disorders, type 1 diabetes, insulin/sulfonylurea users without a doctor.

items.name: Massage
items.tradition: Practices (Ayurveda, TCM tui na, Swedish, Hawaiian lomilomi)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for pain, circulation and relaxation
items.caution: Avoid deep pressure on blood clots, fractures, recent surgery, low platelets.

items.name: Morning sunlight exposure
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for health, mood and vitamin D
items.caution: Sunburn and skin cancer: avoid burning; protect eyes; photosensitizing drugs/herbs (St John's wort).

items.name: Mouth taping (sleep)
items.traditional_use: Promoted for nasal breathing, better sleep and snoring
items.caution: ⚠️ Can worsen undiagnosed sleep apnea; never if nose is blocked, after alcohol/sedatives, or in children.

items.name: Sauna (Finnish, dry heat)
items.tradition: Practices (Finnish; Native sweat traditions; Russian banya)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for cleansing, relaxation and social wellbeing
items.caution: Dehydration, fainting; no alcohol; avoid with unstable heart disease, low BP, pregnancy; men trying to conceive (temporary sperm effect).

items.name: Vitamin D from sun (and supplements)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally sunlight was used against rickets and for vitality
items.caution: Toxicity with high-dose supplements (hypercalcemia).

items.name: Walking (daily steps)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally the oldest medicine ('walking is man's best medicine'—attributed to Hippocrates)
items.caution: Low risk.

items.name: Wim Hof Method (cyclic hyperventilation + cold)
items.traditional_use: Promoted for immunity, energy and cold tolerance
items.caution: ⚠️ Hyperventilation then breath-holding in water has caused drowning deaths; never in/near water or while driving.

items.name: Bee pollen
items.traditional_use: Traditionally an energy and allergy remedy
items.caution: ⚠️ Anaphylaxis in pollen-allergic people; weight-loss products adulterated with drugs.

items.name: Bone broth
items.traditional_use: Traditionally used for recovery, joints, gut and colds
items.caution: Sodium; possible lead from bones (low).

items.name: Probiotic / fermented foods (general)
items.traditional_use: Traditionally fermented foods eaten for digestion
items.caution: Immunocompromised and critically ill: infection risk from live organisms.
